Noah: Looping CS for HelixCare handoff — signed (BAA), monthly $18k, pilot window 2026-04-15. Needs private VPC, Okta SSO, HIPAA logging. Sales called out a potential surge on pilot (est ~600 rps). Risks: cert issuance delays, customer firewall change window, late SAML metadata. @priya @elaine

Priya: I can run onboarding + runbook. Quick ask: who owns cert steps? Also need the Okta admin contact and allowed IP list.

Noah: Certs are customer-managed; contact is itsec@helixcare.org. Sales uploaded initial SAML XML to the account folder: internal link.

Elaine: I'll open infra tickets: SUP-8002 (SSO debug) and ENG-4709 (VPC peering). Need CIDR ranges and preferred peering times from customer.

Noah: Customer provided tentative IP ranges in sheet; sharing in Confluence. Will email itsec@helixcare.org to confirm peering window.

Priya: Action items: 1) Collect final SAML metadata (owner: priya, due: 2026-03-26) 2) Confirm cert handoff steps with itsec@helixcare.org (owner: noah, due: 2026-03-24) 3) ENG preflight + ENG-4709 (owner: elaine) 4) Run privacy-focused enablement + redaction demo (owner: priya, session: 2026-04-07) 5) Pilot surge plan (owner: ops, note: request temporary burst nodes)

Elaine: Posted ENG-4709 and left a comment for itsec@helixcare.org requesting CIDR and peering day/time.

Priya: Example smoke test for CS to run against staging once available:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"input":"PHI check: Patient Jane Doe, MRN 555-66"}'
```

Noah: Customer requested a go/no-go sync on 2026-04-10. Please surface blockers by 2026-04-03.

opsbot: Reminder: follow-up check scheduled 2026-03-30 11:00 PT.

Priya: I'll create the Confluence onboarding page and attach the runbook + ticket links, will update here when done. :thumbsup:

Noah: Marking renewal risk: low for now but flagging adoption metrics for QBR month 6. Thanks all.
